title: Year 2 - Structured intermediate development
description: The 52-week continuation of the curated master course. This route deepens fretboard fluency, chord vocabulary, style, ear skills, arranging and performance readiness.

phases.title: Fretboard and triads
phases.goal: Natural-note map, octaves, CAGED and triad inversions.

phases.title: Rhythm guitar
phases.goal: Power chords, muting and barre-chord fluency.

phases.title: Scales and melody
phases.goal: Major scale positions, sequences and phrase-making.

phases.title: Blues
phases.goal: Shuffle, seventh chords, blues lead, bends and turnarounds.

phases.title: Fingerstyle and acoustic arranging
phases.goal: Bass independence, patterns, melody balance and acoustic arrangement.

phases.title: Repertoire and ear learning
phases.goal: Song form, transcription, chord melody and complete repertoire.

phases.title: Harmony
phases.goal: Intervals, seventh chords, extensions and substitutions.

phases.title: Jazz
phases.goal: Swing, voice leading, bossa nova, jazz melody and jazz blues.

phases.title: Independent musicianship
phases.goal: Practice design, transcription, solo writing, recording and performance.

weeks.title: Fretboard map 1
weeks.focus: Natural notes on low E and A
weeks.checkpoint: Find and name every natural note to fret 5
weeks.practiceExercise: Low E/A note map, 2 minutes daily

weeks.title: Fretboard map 2
weeks.focus: Octaves across adjacent string sets
weeks.checkpoint: Find octave roots on E/A, A/D and D/G strings
weeks.practiceExercise: Root-to-octave jumps in C and G

weeks.title: CAGED and advanced fretboard map
weeks.focus: Connect open shapes, movable regions and octave landmarks
weeks.checkpoint: Trace C, A, G, E and D shapes and name natural-note landmarks through fret 12
weeks.practiceExercise: CAGED map with root notes and octave links across two positions

weeks.title: Triad inversions
weeks.focus: Major triads in root position and inversions
weeks.checkpoint: Play three inversions on the top string set

weeks.title: Minor triad inversions
weeks.focus: Minor colour across the neck
weeks.checkpoint: Move Am, Dm and Em triads between close positions

weeks.title: Quarter review: fretboard
weeks.focus: Test roots, octave links and triads
weeks.checkpoint: Complete a timed note-finding and triad test

weeks.title: Power-chord accuracy
weeks.focus: Root-6 and root-5 power chords
weeks.checkpoint: Name roots while changing power chords

weeks.title: Palm-muted groove
weeks.focus: Switch between open and palm-muted notes
weeks.checkpoint: Control muting with the heel of the picking hand
weeks.practiceExercise: E5 riff: open bar, muted bar

weeks.title: Barre chord refresh
weeks.focus: E-shape major and minor forms
weeks.checkpoint: Move F, G and A barres with short relaxed holds

weeks.title: A-shape barre chords
weeks.focus: Five-string movable shapes and muting
weeks.checkpoint: Play Bm, C#m and Dm as movable shapes

weeks.title: Quarter review: rhythm guitar
weeks.focus: Combine power chords, barres and muting
weeks.checkpoint: Record 16 bars with clear starts and stops
weeks.practiceExercise: Rock rhythm study with two textures

weeks.title: Major scale position 1
weeks.focus: C major/G major scale and root awareness
weeks.checkpoint: Play one position evenly in two keys

weeks.title: Scale sequences
weeks.focus: Thirds and four-note sequences
weeks.checkpoint: Practise a scale in thirds without changing pulse
weeks.practiceExercise: G major in thirds, one octave

weeks.title: Position changes
weeks.focus: Link positions by a shared note
weeks.checkpoint: Shift between two scale patterns with a target note

weeks.title: Major scale phrase-making
weeks.focus: Build melody with chord tones
weeks.checkpoint: Play scale notes then end phrases on chord tones

weeks.title: Quarter review: melody
weeks.focus: Assess scale accuracy, phrasing and timing
weeks.checkpoint: Record one scale, one phrase and one chord-tone landing
weeks.practiceExercise: G major phrase with a clear ending

weeks.title: Blues shuffle 1
weeks.focus: Swing subdivision and shuffle feel
weeks.checkpoint: Keep swung eighths even through 12 bars
weeks.practiceExercise: A shuffle: two-beat riff per chord

weeks.title: Blues shuffle 2
weeks.focus: Open seventh chords and chord changes
weeks.checkpoint: Play A7-D7-E7 in 12-bar form
weeks.practiceExercise: 12-bar blues with two strums per bar

weeks.title: Blues lead vocabulary
weeks.focus: Mix minor pentatonic with chord tones
weeks.checkpoint: Create two motifs over A blues
weeks.practiceExercise: A minor pentatonic motif with rests

weeks.title: Bends and vibrato
weeks.focus: Bend to target pitch and control vibrato
weeks.checkpoint: Match a fretted target before adding vibrato

weeks.title: Blues turnaround
weeks.focus: Connect bar 12 to the next chorus
weeks.checkpoint: Play a turnaround with correct form timing

weeks.title: Quarter review: blues
weeks.focus: Play a complete blues form and lead chorus
weeks.checkpoint: Record 12-bar rhythm and 12-bar solo
weeks.practiceExercise: A blues performance with a clear start and ending

weeks.title: Fingerstyle bass independence
weeks.focus: Keep bass steady while treble notes vary
weeks.checkpoint: Repeat a Travis-style pattern slowly
weeks.practiceExercise: Alternating bass over C and G

weeks.title: Fingerstyle pattern changes
weeks.focus: Shift from arpeggio to syncopated pattern
weeks.checkpoint: Keep thumb steady across chord changes

weeks.title: Fingerstyle melody balance
weeks.focus: Bring out top melody over accompaniment
weeks.checkpoint: Play melody notes louder without rushing bass
weeks.practiceExercise: Four-bar melody on a bass pattern

weeks.title: Percussive and muted accents
weeks.focus: Add light percussive texture safely
weeks.checkpoint: Integrate one muted accent per bar
weeks.practiceExercise: Acoustic groove with rest and accent

weeks.title: Arrange a folk piece
weeks.focus: Create intro, verse and ending from one progression
weeks.checkpoint: Arrange two sections using fingerstyle and strumming

weeks.title: Quarter review: acoustic
weeks.focus: Record an acoustic piece with stable dynamics
weeks.checkpoint: Compare rhythm-only and fingerstyle takes

weeks.title: Song form and sections
weeks.focus: Hear verse, chorus, bridge and turnarounds
weeks.checkpoint: Map the form of one song before learning it

weeks.title: Learn by ear: rhythm
weeks.focus: Transcribe strumming accents and rests
weeks.checkpoint: Write a four-bar rhythm after listening

weeks.title: Learn by ear: bass
weeks.focus: Find the root movement under a progression
weeks.checkpoint: Identify roots before adding chord names

weeks.title: Learn by ear: melody
weeks.focus: Transcribe a 5-8 note phrase
weeks.checkpoint: Sing, locate and verify each note by ear

weeks.title: Chord melody II
weeks.focus: Add inner voices to a short melody
weeks.checkpoint: Keep the top voice connected through chord changes

weeks.title: Quarter review: repertoire
weeks.focus: Learn a complete piece from map to performance
weeks.checkpoint: Record form, transitions and ending

weeks.title: Music theory: intervals
weeks.focus: Identify intervals by sound and fretboard distance
weeks.checkpoint: Play and sing unison, thirds, fifths and octaves

weeks.title: Build seventh chords
weeks.focus: Construct maj7, m7 and dominant 7 from formulas
weeks.checkpoint: Name chord tones before finding a shape

weeks.title: Chord extensions
weeks.focus: Add 9ths and suspended tones tastefully
weeks.checkpoint: Compare basic triad and extended version

weeks.title: Chord substitution
weeks.focus: Try one substitution and explain its function
weeks.checkpoint: Keep melody common tones where possible

weeks.title: Quarter review: harmony
weeks.focus: Create a progression, analyse and perform it
weeks.checkpoint: Label Roman numerals and play in two keys

weeks.title: Jazz swing comping
weeks.focus: Use a relaxed swing feel and sparse voicings
weeks.checkpoint: Keep 2 and 4 in the body while comping

weeks.title: Jazz ii-V-I voice leading
weeks.focus: Resolve guide tones with small movements
weeks.checkpoint: Track the third and seventh through the sequence

weeks.title: Bossa nova foundation
weeks.focus: Play a repeating bass/chord pattern
weeks.checkpoint: Keep bass pulse stable and chord attacks quiet

weeks.title: Jazz melody phrasing
weeks.focus: Play melody, comp and short solo over a form
weeks.checkpoint: Leave space and use chord tones at changes

weeks.title: Jazz blues
weeks.focus: Combine 12-bar form and seventh chords
weeks.checkpoint: Keep chord changes clear through a jazz blues
weeks.practiceExercise: F jazz blues: roots and guide tones

weeks.title: Quarter review: jazz
weeks.focus: Record a short melody-comp-solo arrangement
weeks.checkpoint: Keep form without written prompts

weeks.title: Practice architecture
weeks.focus: Build a weekly practice menu by priority
weeks.checkpoint: Use maintenance, growth and repertoire slots

weeks.title: Transcribe a phrase
weeks.focus: Copy articulation, rhythm and pitch from a reference
weeks.checkpoint: Transcribe 4-8 notes, including rhythm

weeks.title: Write a solo chorus
weeks.focus: Use motifs, space and chord tones over progression
weeks.checkpoint: Plan opening, development and ending

weeks.title: Arrangement, dynamics and style comparison
weeks.focus: Create contrast without losing the pulse
weeks.checkpoint: Record the same 8-bar progression in two styles with different dynamics
weeks.practiceExercise: One progression: acoustic strum versus rock groove

weeks.title: Recording craft
weeks.focus: Balance levels and capture a clean one-take performance
weeks.checkpoint: Check tuning, noise, timing and dynamic balance

weeks.title: Rehearsal, stamina and a 3-piece set
weeks.focus: Prepare a short set with reliable transitions
weeks.checkpoint: Perform three short pieces in sequence with count-ins, planned endings and recovery points
weeks.practiceExercise: Three-piece set: acoustic, rhythm-guitar and lead/blues excerpts

weeks.title: Year 2 mock exam and next-path plan
weeks.focus: Assess repertoire, fretboard, harmony and performance readiness
weeks.checkpoint: Record prepared repertoire, reading or TAB, a progression and a short improvised phrase; choose a Year 3+ path
weeks.practiceExercise: Year 2 capstone: prepared piece + progression + 8-bar lead
